import time import random from datetime import datetime def rainstorm_ai( rain_mm, humidity, temp_now, temp_30min_ago, wind_speed, cloud_density ): temp_drop = temp_30min_ago - temp_now stage = "普通" if rain_mm > 0.2 and humidity > 75 and temp_now > 26: stage = "毛毛雨生成" if (humidity > 82 and wind_speed > 4 and temp_drop >= 2 and cloud_density > 70): stage = "對流雲成長" if (rain_mm > 3 and humidity > 88 and cloud_density > 85 and wind_speed > 6): stage = "暴雨模式" return stage # 逢甲雨爆模式 v3.0（已優化） def rain_burst_mode(duration_minutes=8): print("⚠️ 逢甲雨爆模式啟動 - 台中西屯區 2026-06-20 07:00\~10:00") print("🌧️ 整合雨量模擬模式") print("=" * 90) duration = duration_minutes * 60 start_time = time.time() rain = 12 # 初始低雨量（根據今天實際預報） while True: elapsed = int(time.time() - start_time) if elapsed >= duration: break progress = elapsed / duration burst = int((progress ** 1.3) * 28) # 調整為較緩和上升 random_wave = random.randint(-4, 5) current_rain = min(85, rain + burst + random_wave) # 上限調整 # 狀態判定 if current_rain >= 82: status = "⛈️ 極端暴雨" thunder = "⚡⚡⚡" elif current_rain >= 70: status = "🌧️ 豪大雨" thunder = "⚡⚡" elif current_rain >= 50: status = "🌧️ 強降雨" thunder = "⚡" else: status = "☁️ 雨雲增強" thunder = "" cloud_count = min(12, current_rain // 7) clouds = "☁️" * cloud_count rain_fx = "🌧️" * (cloud_count // 2) wind = min(9, int(progress * 10)) wind_fx = "💨" * wind order_mode = "🔥 爆單區" if current_rain >= 78 else "🛵 高單價區" if current_rain >= 60 else "📦 普通區" now = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S") print( f"[{now}] {clouds}{rain_fx} " f"降雨率 {current_rain}% | " f"{status} {thunder} | " f"{order_mode} | 風場 {wind_fx}" ) time.sleep(2.0) # 加速顯示 print("\n" + "=" * 90) print("🌧️ 逢甲07:00\~10:00 雨爆模式結束") print("✅ 今日實際預報：低雨量，無暴雨") print("=" * 90) # ========================= # MAIN - 執行 # ========================= if __name__ == "__main__": # 先用AI判斷階段 stage = rainstorm_ai( rain_mm=0.5, # 低 humidity=78, temp_now=27, temp_30min_ago=27.5, wind_speed=3.5, cloud_density=55 ) print(f"🌡️ rainstorm_ai 判斷：{stage}\n") try: rain_burst_mode(duration_minutes=8) except KeyboardInterrupt: print("\n⛔ 已停止") except Exception as e: print("❌ 錯誤:", e) print("\n🌧️ 台中逢甲雨量監測系統結束") import time import random from datetime import datetime def rainstorm_ai( rain_mm, humidity, temp_now, temp_30min_ago, wind_speed, cloud_density ): temp_drop = temp_30min_ago - temp_now stage = "普通" if rain_mm > 0.2 and humidity > 75 and temp_now > 26: stage = "毛毛雨生成" if ( humidity > 82 and wind_speed > 4 and temp_drop >= 2 and cloud_density > 70 ): stage = "對流雲成長" if ( rain_mm > 3 and humidity > 88 and cloud_density > 85 and wind_speed > 6 ): stage = "暴雨模式" return stage result = rainstorm_ai( rain_mm=5, humidity=90, temp_now=25, temp_30min_ago=29, wind_speed=7, cloud_density=90 ) print(result) # ========================= # 逢甲雨爆模式 v3.0 # Fengjia Storm Mode # ========================= def rain_burst_mode(duration_minutes=8): print("⚠️ 逢甲雨爆模式啟動") print("🌧️ 暴雨雲層快速聚集") print("💨 西屯區風場異常增強") print("=" * 90) duration = duration_minutes * 60 start_time = time.time() # 初始值 rain = 58 while True: elapsed = int(time.time() - start_time) if elapsed >= duration: break progress = elapsed / duration # 暴雨加速演算法 burst = int((progress ** 1.45) * 45) # 閃爍波動 random_wave = random.randint(-3, 6) # 最終雨勢 current_rain = min(98, rain + burst + random_wave) # 雷暴判定 if current_rain >= 90: status = "⛈️ 極端暴雨" thunder = "⚡⚡⚡" elif current_rain >= 80: status = "🌧️ 豪大雨" thunder = "⚡⚡" elif current_rain >= 70: status = "🌧️ 強降雨" thunder = "⚡" else: status = "☁️ 雨雲增強" thunder = "" # 雲層 cloud_count = min(12, current_rain // 8) clouds = "☁️" * cloud_count rain_fx = "🌧️" * (cloud_count // 2) # 風力 wind = min(10, int(progress * 12)) wind_fx = "💨" * wind # 爆單模式 if current_rain >= 85: order_mode = "🔥 爆單區" elif current_rain >= 70: order_mode = "🛵 高單價區" else: order_mode = "📦 普通區" now = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S") print( f"[{now}] " f"{clouds}{rain_fx} " f"降雨率 {current_rain}% | " f"{status} {thunder} | " f"{order_mode} | " f"風場 {wind_fx}" ) time.sleep(2.5) print("\n" + "=" * 90) print("⛈️ 逢甲雨爆模式完成") print("🌧️ 西屯區已進入高濕度暴雨狀態") print("🛵 外送動態單價可能提升") print("=" * 90) # ========================= # MAIN # ========================= if __name__ == "__main__": try: rain_burst_mode(duration_minutes=8) except KeyboardInterrupt: print("\n⛔ 使用者中止") except Exception as e: print("❌ 系統錯誤:", e) print("\n🌧️ 系統結束")# AI 防災指揮台 · 雙貓眼安全系統
